Name: Special Order Adjustments
Author: Smashley41
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Special Order Adjustments[/size][/u][/b]

This mod makes a number of adjustments to the Special Order rewards that I felt were lacking in the vanilla game, such as replacing duplicate rewards and adding friendship boosts where they were missing.

Everything can be turned on/off in the config options. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is [i][u]highly recommended[/u]. [/i]Let's get into the details...


[b]
[size=4]**ALTERNATE REWARDS**[/size][/b]
Several Special Order quests in the vanilla game have duplicated rewards, the most notorious example for me being [i]Aquatic Overpopulation[/i] and [i]Biome Balance[/i] both awarding the Farm Computer crafting recipe, which is a completely useless reward the second time you receive it. Similarly, [i]Pierre's Prime Produce[/i] and [i]Crop Order[/i] both reward you with a Mini-Shipping Bin, which may not be to everyone's liking.

This mod offers the following alternate rewards...

[list]
[*][i][b]Aquatic Overpopulation[/b] - [/i]Choose from one of 12 different items or 5 different crafting recipes. To ensure the reward is unique upon completing the quest, your chosen crafting recipe will have its vanilla source removed from the game, and, in some cases your chosen item will have its availability for purchase restricted until after quest completion.
[*][i][b]Pierre's Prime Produce[/b] - [/i]Choose from one of 7 different items, 1 random pool of items, or 4 different crafting recipes. As per the [i]Aquatic Overpopulation[/i] rewards, your chosen crafting recipe will have the vanilla method of obtaining that recipe removed from the game.
[*][i][b]Robin's Project[/b] - [/i]Choose to have the Deluxe Red Double Bed actually mailed to you as a reward, instead of having to pay 6,000g for one.
[*][i][b]Tropical Fish[/b] - [/i]Choose to receive an Aquatic Sanctuary instead of the underwhelming Deluxe Fish Tank (which is available in the furniture catalogue anyway). This will hide the Aquatic Sanctuary from Qi's Walnut Room until you have completed the quest, and the Deluxe Fish Tank will be available from Willy at the start of the game.
[/list]
Expand the spoiler below for the list of selectable rewards.
[spoiler][b]Aquatic Overpopulation:
[/b]Bait Maker (item or crafting recipe)
Calendar*
Crystalarium (item or crafting recipe)
Deconstructor
Deluxe Worm Bin (item or crafting recipe)
Fish Smoker (item or crafting recipe)
Heavy Tapper
Hopper
Mushroom Log (item or crafting recipe)
Telephone*
Wood Chipper
Workbench*

*choosing this item will remove it from Robin's store until after you have completed the quest.

[b]
Pierre's Prime Produce:
[/b]Butterfly Hutch
Deluxe Fertilizer (item x24 or crafting recipe)
Deluxe Retaining Soil (item x24 or crafting recipe)
Hyper Speed-Gro (item x24 or crafting recipe)
Iridium Sprinkler (crafting recipe)
Prairie King Arcade System
Quality Sprinkler (x5)
Random Deluxe Fertilizer (x24, randomly selected from Deluxe Fertilizer, Deluxe Retaining Soil or Hyper Speed-Gro)
Soda Machine

For both quests, the mail letters are slightly edited to reflect the new item you are receiving, especially in the case of Pierre's Prime Produce, which has a unique letter for almost every reward![/spoiler]



[b][size=4]**FRIENDSHIP BOOSTS**[/size][/b]
Only 4 out of 18 Special Orders normally reward friendship points with the quest-giver. All of the repeatable orders do not offer friendship as a reward, which I assume is for balance reasons so players cannot spam friendship points for the chosen NPC. This does not concern me, as I only do each special order once per playthrough.

If this feature interests you, you can enable friendship boosts (of 1 heart) for each Special Order that is missing this feature...

[list]
[*]Caroline, for [i][b]Island Ingredients[/b][/i]
[*]Clint, for [i][b]Cave Patrol[/b][/i]
[*]Demetrius, for [i][b]Aquatic Overpopulation[/b][/i]
[*]Demetrius, for [i][b]Biome Balance[/b][/i]
[*]Evelyn, for [i][b]Gifts for George[/b][/i]
[*]Gunther, for [i][b]Fragments of the Past[/b] [/i](if you are using a mod that adds him as an NPC)
[*]Gus, for [i][b]Gus' Famous Omelet[/b][/i]
[*]Lewis, for [i][b]Crop Order[/b][/i]
[*]Pierre, for [i][b]Pierre's Prime Produce[/b][/i]
[*]Robin, for [i][b]Robin's Resource Rush[/b][/i]
[*]Willy, for [i][b]Juicy Bugs Wanted![/b][/i]
[*]Willy, for [i][b]Tropical Fish[/b][/i]
[*]Wizard, for [i][b]A Curious Substance[/b][/i]
[*]Wizard, for [i][b]Prismatic Jelly[/b][/i]
[/list]


[b][size=4]**EXTENDED FRIENDSHIP BOOSTS**[/size]
[/b]Why stop at friendship boosts with the quest-giver! It's not always the quest-giver that benefits from your actions. Many characters enjoy Gus's omelet, for example, surely they should regard you a little more highly afterwards!

If you so choose, this mod adds the following extended friendship boosts...

[list]
[*][i][b]Gifts for George[/b][/i][i] - [/i]Earn a variable number of hearts with George based on your dialogue choices during the event when he is receiving his gifts! (Or if you disable Event Edits, gain a chosen amount of friendship points with him upon quest completion!)
[*][i][b]Gus' Famous Omelet[/b] - [/i]Earn half a friendship heart with the other participants in the meal - Robin, Pam, Willy, Lewis and Marnie.
[*][i][b]Robin's Project[/b] - [/i]Side with Demetrius or Robin during the bed event and gain some extra points with either Demetrius or Sebastian based on your choices. (Or if you diable Event Edits, gain a friendship boost with the other participants - Demetrius, Sebastian and Maru - upon quest completion.)
[*][i][b]Rock Rejuvenation[/b] - [/i]Earn half a friendship heart with the other participants in the rock rejuvenation ceremony - Marnie, Caroline, Abigail and Haley. If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is installed, this will also include Olivia.
[*][i][b]The Strong Stuff[/b][/i] - Earn half a friendship heart with Penny. This one's a little bit of scope creep because she's not involved in the quest, but I like to think she is secretly grateful that you didn't give her mother alcohol! Perhaps she will thank you personally?
[/list]


[size=4][b]**EXTRA CONTENT**[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][i][b]Coffee Maker Availability[/b][/i] - You can choose to make the Coffee Maker available for purchase after completing the [i]Gifts for George[/i] quest. And why shouldn't you be able to do this! Whether through crafting or purchasing, more copies of every other Special Order reward can be obtained after completing the associated quest. Now the Coffee Maker can be purchased too (your choices are the Carpenter Shop, the Saloon, Sandy's Oasis, the Desert or Island Trader, or the Casino).
[*][i][b]Joja Cola is Trash[/b][/i] - Makes the Joja Cola an acceptable collection and donation for the [i]Community Cleanup[/i] quest. Finally you can treat that Joja Cola with the disdain it deserves! This does mean you can complete the quest by buying 20x Joja Colas, but you wouldn't do that! This does [i]not [/i]make the Joja Cola recyclable. For that I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11953]Recycle Joja Cola[/url]﻿.
[/list]


[size=4][b]**NOTES, COMPATIBILITY ETC.**
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Should be compatible with anything that doesn't edit the vanilla special order quest rewards or the two events I have edited.
[*]Untested, but likely [i]incompatible[/i] with the money rewards multiplier of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22719]Special Order Tweaks[/url], but if you turn that feature off in their config, you should be able to use the other features of that mod along with this one.﻿
[*]Any mod that adds Gunther as a full NPC should work with the Gunther Friendship Boost. Tested with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7102]Make Gunther Real[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2569]Befriend Marlon and Gunther[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url]﻿ (with the [i]Social Gunther and Marlon[/i] config turned on), and it should work with any other mods that add him as an NPC, as long as his internal name is "Gunther"!
[*]The Event Edits for [i]Gifts for George[/i] and [i]Robin's Project [/i]can be turned off, in case you have other mods that edit these events (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19854]Demetrius on the Spectrum[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14534]Robin and Demetrius's Better Bed Discussion[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23097]Demetrius's Tomato Aesthetics[/url]﻿).
[*]If Event Edits are turned off and Extended Friendship Boosts are turned on, the mod will still account for this and award the extended friendship boosts upon completion of the quest instead of during the event.
[*]Furthermore, where quests have adjustments in multiple categories, the mod should account for all permutations of options in different sections being turned on and off, and the config tooltips will describe how options interact and whether other options are required for certain things to work.
[*]Will conflict with my previous mod - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24028]Aquatic Overpopulation - Alternate Rewards[/url]﻿ (now hidden) - if you have it installed. This mod supersedes that one. Uninstall the old mod and install this one instead and set the [i]Aquatic Overpopulation[/i] options to the same as you had them in the older mod.
[*]To the best of my knowledge is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿. Personally, I do not play with that mod, but I looked at its Special Orders code and the only vanilla Special Order that SVE alters is the [i]Rock Rejuvenation[/i] order, and I have made this mod compatible with their changes!
[/list]


[size=4][b]**INSTALLATION**[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] are installed
[*]Unzip the mod file to your Stardew Valley Mods folder
[*]Load your game and turn on the features you want through GMCM
[/list]


[b][size=4]**TRANSLATIONS**[/size][/b]
An i18n file is included. You are welcome to create your own translations under the following conditions...
[list]
[*]You translate the file yourself, without using AI
[*]You upload ONLY the i18n file and NOT the full mod
[*]You list this mod as a requirement
[/list]
If you create a translation please let me know, I will add a link to it on this page with credit to its creator.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41175]Brazilian Portuguese translation[/url] - thank you to Maatsuki


[b]
Lastly, a big thank you for checking out this mod! I worked hard on this, and I hope you enjoy it!
